aura.color.surface.description: Glass fill — translucent over mesh orbs

aura.guide.accent.value: Sky blue owns FAB, active nav, and user chat. Metric hues (progress/heart/calories/steps) are status only, not brand.

aura.guide.atmosphere.value: Every screen sits on the soft mesh gradient (bg → bgMid → bgAlt); never flat white or solid dark.

aura.guide.bgFill.description: Compose screen background as layered gradient fill

aura.guide.chat.value: User = solid accent bubble; AI = glass bubble; media embeds inside AI bubbles with labeled callouts.

aura.guide.chrome.value: Bottom nav is a glass island inset from edges; primary action is a circular blue FAB with glow shadow.

aura.guide.depth.value: Layer gradient → glass → solid accent controls → 3D clay assets. Ink is tinted charcoal, not pure black.

aura.guide.geometry.value: Large radii (lg/xl) on panels; pills for inputs, chips, and the floating tab bar.

aura.guide.glass.value: Surfaces use translucent white + backdrop blur + light border + soft shadow. One glass plane per section; avoid nested glass.

aura.guide.mode.value: experience — calm softness and presence over dense clinical chrome

aura.guide.playful.value: 3D mascot/organ renders carry warmth; icons stay thin-stroke (~2px), colored by metric role.

aura.guide.spacing.value: Card padding 20 · stack gap 16 · screen inset 20–24.
